name: The Cradled Fossil
visual_description: A curled embryo of bone and spiral. Part shell, part fetus, part sarcophagus. It protects nothing but the echo of its own birth.
meaning: Womb as tomb. Beginning as end.
existential_reflection: I was reborn in extinction. Mizontresh showed me this loop: I killed to emerge, only to die inside that emergence. Every cycle *begins in guilt.*
